sources.title: Annexe fiscale à la loi de Finances n°2025-987 du 19 décembre 2025 (gestion 2026)
sources.institution: Direction Générale du Budget et des Finances (DGBF), Côte d'Ivoire
sources.coverage: confirms standard VAT rate ("taux de droit commun de TVA de 18%") via Article 6 (rationalisation des exonérations) amending Article 355 of the Code Général des Impôts
sources.notes: Full PDF is 10.5 MB (over the ~5 MB direct-archive threshold); only the operative excerpt covering Article 6 (pages ~8-11) was extracted and archived as text, with the SHA-256 of that excerpt recorded under sha256. The SHA-256 of the full original PDF, for independent re-verification by re-download, is recorded under source_document_sha256 (not committed to the repository, per the Cameroon precedent). This Finance Law annex references the CGI's Article 355 series (355-17, 355-27, 355-28, 355-30) as being brought up to the common-law rate; it does NOT itself contain the base rate-setting article of the CGI (reported by secondary sources as Article 359, not independently verified in this document).
